title: The magpie remembered his scarf 🧣🥺
description:
Last winter he gave his only scarf to keep three baby magpies warm.
This winter, someone remembered.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#Kindness #Magpie #Seoul #Korea #Wholesome #shorts
pinned: Has a kindness ever come back to you? 🧣 Tell Kachi 💛

cuts.cap: Last winter, he gave away his only scarf.
This winter, he had nothing warm.

end.phrase: Kachi brings you love, from Korea
